name: Tug Drive Field
desc:
Each ship fitted with this drive adds %s to the fleet's maximum burn level. The first also increases fleet acceleration by %s; each additional ship provides %s of the previous ship's acceleration bonus. Mothballed ships provide no bonus. These effects do not apply during %s.

The tug's drive field extends around nearby ships to help them keep pace.
short: Increases fleet burn level and acceleration outside Sustained Burn.

name: Salvage Bays
desc:
Deploying this ship increases the chance that salvageable enemy fighters leave wrecks. These remain recoverable for %s seconds. LYNE drones tow them to the bays for repair. Fighters launched by this ship never leave salvageable wrecks.

The bays have the clamps and handling equipment needed to take wrecks aboard during combat.
short: LYNE drones recover wrecked enemy fighters.
